scope: Headless NES and Game Boy APU cores, built from the files listed here out of the two submodules; no player, CPU, ROM/music loader, game asset, upstream build file or binary.
audit: Pinned recursive GitHub Git Trees and Git Blobs API; audited transitive includes, source license notices, model branches, filter arithmetic and allocation cleanup. Build/runtime evidence is recorded in the project changelog and task ledger.

license_files: blargg/blip_buf.c (embedded complete MIT license, Copyright 2003-2009 Shay Green)

backend.nes: Nes_Apu, Nes_Oscs and one C++ Blip_Buffer implementation.
backend.gb: Upstream supported blip_buf C backend: gb_apu.c + blargg/blip_wrap.c + blargg/blip_buf.c; no GB copy of Blip_Buffer.
excluded_conditional_includes: gme/blargg_config.h: config.h only with HAVE_CONFIG_H; not enabled by this target.
gme/blargg_source.h: BLARGG_SOURCE_BEGIN optional injection; not enabled.
gme/Blip_Buffer.cpp: BLARGG_ENABLE_OPTIMIZER optional injection; not enabled.
gb_apu/blargg/blip_buf.c: blargg_test.h only with BLARGG_TEST; not enabled.

changes: Add const active_channels host inspection without emulation advancement or IRQ acknowledgement; CPU read_status(time) samples time-1 and cannot be used at frame-relative time zero.
Add const dmc_playing playback inspection including the buffered byte and output shifter after the CPU-visible read counter reaches zero.
patches.applied_on: the fork branch, one commit per change

changes: high_pass: replace signed negative left shift and overflow-prone int intermediates with int64_t scaling/subtraction/product; preserve arithmetic-shift floor rounding using division.
apu_read_samples: compare disabled charge factor against 1 << CAPACITOR_SCALE, not CAPACITOR_SCALE.
apu_reset: clear both high-pass capacitors under GB_APU_HAS_MATH_H without recalculating filter coefficients.
PSG mixer: correct NR51 routing and NR50 volume nibble assignments to hardware high=left, low=right.
Wave mixer: use right_volume for every right-channel wave transition, not left_volume.

channel_sync_psg: apply initial amplitude, envelope, routing and channel-disable deltas at base_clock, not the next oscillator edge or arbitrary sync end; retain oscillator timer edges independently. Removes host-block-dependent envelope timing.
patches.applied_on: the fork branch, one commit per change

changes: blip_read_samples: replace negative signed left shift in the integrator high-pass step with bounded multiplication.
patches.applied_on: the fork branch, one commit per change

gb_behavior.models: Distinct DMG/CGB reset wave-register defaults, active-wave-RAM access restrictions, DMG wave retrigger corruption, powered-off length writes and power-off length preservation; CGB exposes PCM12/PCM34. AGB API remains within the upstream core but is not a product model.
gb_behavior.highpass: GB_APU_HAS_MATH_H enables actual model capacitor filtering: DMG charge 0.999958, CGB 0.998943, sample coefficient pow(charge, clock/sample). Init selects NONE; Engine must explicitly select model filter off audio thread. Reset clears capacitor history locally. C blip_buf independently applies its fixed bass_shift=9 integrator high-pass.
gb_behavior.equalization: apu_set_bass and apu_set_treble are intentionally unavailable/no-ops with upstream C backend; no product controls should call them.
gb_behavior.timing: Engine must clock apu_frame_sequencer_clock externally (normal DIV falling-edge cadence every 8192 chip cycles). apu_end_frame clears synthesis clock offsets, not absolute channel timestamps; apu_update_timestamp is available for rebasing.
gb_behavior.samples: apu_clocks_needed, apu_samples_avaliable and apu_read_samples count interleaved stereo scalar samples, not frames; use even counts. Each C blip buffer allocates sampleRate/10 mono samples, requiring render chunks under capacity.
gb_behavior.reset_wave: Upstream hardware power-on wave-RAM register defaults are retained; Engine overwrites them with user semantic wave data. No commercial/game ROM or music samples are included.
gb_behavior.accuracy: Upstream retains an unresolved envelope timer wrap comment; no claim of cycle-perfect or analog-identical hardware accuracy. Save states omit filters/resampler/type/settings and are not suitable for semantic product persistence.
gb_behavior.allocation: apu_init checks calloc and blip wrapper allocation and cleans partial state via apu_quit; wrapper handles either mono-buffer allocation failing; blip_new handles malloc failure. No local allocation patch required.

integration.tests: Root family loop registers Emulation_ApuEngineTest against score_emulation_apu; host-only Emulation_ApuDocumentTest also links score_addon_emulation.
